papers.title: LUTSeg: A Longitudinal Multi-Expert Dataset for Ulcer Tissue Segmentation
papers.authors: Karen Sanchez, Carlos Hinojosa, Albert A. Ávila, Andrea C. Riano-Rojas, Diego H. Romero, Jenny C. Páez, Martina Llinás, Bernard Ghanem
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, medical image, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Saudi Arabia; Subred Norte E.S.E, Hospital Simón Bolívar, Colombia; Universidad del Rosario, Bogotá, Colombia
papers.intro: 本文提出了LUTSeg——一个包含141张麻风病相关溃疡图像、由5位临床专家标注5种组织类别的纵向多专家数据集，并提出了TiSage半监督组织分割框架，通过融合冻结医学视觉语言模型的多尺度语义先验与教师-学生架构，在低标注率场景下显著提升了组织分割性能。

papers.title: Learning Late, Guiding Early: Timestep-Decoupled Semantic Guidance for Fair Face Generation
papers.authors: Subir Kumar Parida, Rajbabu Velmurugan, Ketan Kotwal, R. S. Sengar, Swati Hiremath
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (B.A.R.C.), Mumbai, India; Department of Electrical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai, India
papers.intro: 本文提出 Semantic Boundary Predictor (SBP)，一种推理时的一次性引导框架，通过在不同扩散时间步解耦语义边界学习与语义引导，在不重新训练或微调潜在扩散模型的情况下实现公平的人脸生成。

papers.title: Precipitation Downscaling Using Foundation Model-Conditioned Diffusion
papers.authors: Victor Nascimento Ribeiro, Jorge Guevara, Jorge Sebastian Moraga, Chris Lucas, Natalie Lord, Andrew Taylor, Edward Lockhart, Will Trojak, Johannes Schmude, Anne Jones
papers.tags: diffusion model, image generation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: IBM Research, Fathom, STFC Hartree Centre
papers.intro: 本文系统比较了三种条件化策略（通道拼接、可学习卷积编码器的交叉注意力、预训练天气基础模型Prithvi WxC的交叉注意力）对扩散模型降水降尺度性能的影响，发现交叉注意力条件化在分布真实性和极端事件捕捉方面优于简单拼接，且预训练基础模型在数据有限场景下具有显著优势。

papers.title: DEFUSE: Generalizable Backdoor Defense for Self-Supervised Encoders with Generative Priors
papers.authors: Tuo Chen, Jie Gui, Minjing Dong, Lanting Fang, Ju Jia, Benlei Cui, Jian Liu

papers.title: Socialized Detector Learning: Trajectory-Guided and Reciprocal Distillation for Heterogeneous Object Detectors

papers.title: Label-Free Foundational Model Selection for Medical Image Classification under Distribution Shift via Pseudo Label Discrepancy
papers.authors: Juan Iñaki Larrea, Lucas Mansilla, Enzo Ferrante
papers.tags: CLIP, image classification
papers.affiliations: Applied Artificial Intelligence Lab (LIAA), Computer Sciences Institute (ICC), Universidad de Buenos Aires - CONICET, Argentina; Research Institute for Signals, Systems and Computational Intelligence, sinc(i), Universidad Nacional del Litoral - CONICET, Argentina
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于伪标签差异的无标签模型选择准则（AURCC），利用SUDO框架在无目标域标注的情况下对多个医学影像基础模型进行排序，在胸部X光肺炎分类任务中有效恢复真实性能排序，尤其在源域标注数据稀缺时优于传统基线方法。

papers.title: Bootstrapping a 4D LiDAR Annotation Tool from Video Foundation Models
papers.authors: Jihun Kim, Hyun-Kurl Jang, Hyemin Yang, Jinnyeong Yang, Hyeokjun Kweon, Kuk-Jin Yoon

papers.title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
papers.authors: Andreas Hochlehnert, Marianna Nezhurina, Mehdi Cherti, Andrej Radonjic, Thaddäus Wiedemer, Christoph Schuhmann, Romain Beaumont, Wieland Brendel, Bernhard Schölkopf, A. Sophia Koepke, Jenia Jitsev, Matthias Bethge

papers.intro: 本文提出了LAION-BVD，一个包含8000万视频、总时长1000万小时的超大规模开放多模态视频数据集，并配套了可扩展的多模态标注流水线，验证了其在视频-文本、音频-文本和图像-文本预训练中的有效性。

papers.title: MoE-based Feature Adapter for Prompt-free Binary Coronary Artery Segmentation in X-ray Angiography

papers.title: Interpretable Fundus Image Classification via Ring-Based Retinal Vasculature Features
papers.authors: Xiaoyan Li, Shixin Xu, Arvind Gupta, Huaxiong Huang

papers.title: ReGround-Surg: Reliability-Guided Anchor Grounding for Referring Surgical Video Segmentation
papers.authors: Jiaxin Wen, Ming Yin, Lu Liu, Zeyu Fu

papers.title: X-MULTI: VLM-based Imaging Factor Disentanglement for Factor-Aware Image Synthesis

papers.title: Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation of SAM for Surgical Instrument Segmentation

papers.title: It depends: Incorporating correlations for joint aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties of high-dimensional output spaces
papers.authors: Leonhard F. Feiner, Manuel Nickel, Martin Menten, Laurin Lux, Rickmer Braren, Daniel Rueckert, Georgios Kaissis, Raphael Rehms, Johannes Paetzold
papers.tags: depth estimation, image generation

papers.title: DoublesEval: Diagnosing Multi-Agent Tactical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Professional Doubles Badminton

papers.title: Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion for Robust End-to-End Driving under Asymmetric Sensor Degradation
